purpose: Static capability inventory and accepted ownership mapping; not an executable action registry or proof of runtime parity

reference.provenance: Reference revisions supplied by integration owner; scanned content is identified by source hashes below

method.sourceScope: Recursive regular source files in public/lib/bin, three package entry sources, native parity JSON and feature destination contract; no dependencies, tests, app execution or settings reads
limits: Quoted HTML attributes and literal markup candidates only; JS-created controls are represented by source functions/dynamic families, not complete DOM instances.
JavaScript scanning is lexical, not an AST or call graph. Nearest preceding named function is a locator only; anonymous callbacks inherit that locator.
Source IDs and symbol/data anchors identify records; line numbers are navigation hints. Anonymous tag hashes can change when markup changes; duplicate instances use occurrence suffixes.

Browser key declarations and access expressions are enumerated. Dynamic keys remain expressions. Server settings contracts are linked in capability-ledger.md; schema references do not prove writes or runtime availability.
Family matching is a deterministic lexical annotation. Unresolved entries require human reconciliation; zero unresolved would not establish runtime parity.

dynamicFamilies.limit: Retained view identity differs from cancellation target.
DOM-created dialog plus live page/revision controls has no source ID.
Computed button/span tags depend on the current payload and action callback.
Extension blocking requests reuse extensionDialog; do not invent static request IDs.
UI metadata is separate from canonical package identities.
Rows/actions are data-dependent; no fictional per-file static controls.
DOM-created dialog has no source ID.
Action buttons depend on message content and callbacks; preserve originating message.
One static dialog hosts many live selectors, resource profiles and settings forms.
Provider/model availability is tab catalog data.
Runtime tab identities; no static session instances.
Questionnaire controls depend on response data; preserve Other and explicit submission.
Shared constructors have no independent capability or runtime instance.
Discovered skills and enabled scopes are dynamic.
Native, extension and skill commands depend on the selected tab; palette truncates to 140.
